import ast, hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

p=Path(sys.argv[1])/'audit-v2'
source=(p/'audit_v2.py').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest()=='400b782260daf3b0fe4ebd5d06b79057cf00d7dde277acc2eda1f64ee2f5df36'
tree=ast.parse(source)
nodes=[n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,(ast.Import,ast.ImportFrom))
       or getattr(n,'name',None) in ('exact','scope','audit')
       or isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id in ('KINDS','ORDER') for t in n.targets)]
ns={'__name__':'saved_record_probe'}
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=nodes,type_ignores=[]),'v2-pure-functions','exec'),ns)
c=json.loads((p/'inputs/client.json').read_bytes())
s=json.loads((p/'inputs/server.json').read_bytes())
assert ns['audit'](c,s)['errors']==[]
e=s['events'];commit=e.pop(6)
assert commit['event']=='commit' and commit['evidence_ref']=='read-1' and commit['request_id']=='w1'
i=next(i for i,v in enumerate(e) if v['event']=='read_return' and v['read_id']==1)
commit['ns']=e[i-1]['ns'];e.insert(i,commit)
for i,v in enumerate(e):v['seq']=i
data=json.dumps(s,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=True).encode()+b'\n'
assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()=='714fd93b3c26fdbfbdb7862d5ff91122308e4ac78f115b58b2e6cb563148e3b9'
effect=next(i for i,v in enumerate(e) if v['event']=='commit' and v['evidence_ref']=='read-1' and v['request_id']=='w1')
returned=next(i for i,v in enumerate(e) if v['event']=='read_return' and v['read_id']==1)
assert effect<returned
result=ns['audit'](c,s)
assert result['errors']==[] and result['equivalent_cohort_latency_gain_observed'] is True
print(json.dumps(dict(copy_sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),copy_bytes=len(data),commit_index=effect,read_return_index=returned,
    supplied_errors=result['errors'],supplied_latency_gain=result['equivalent_cohort_latency_gain_observed'],original_browser_or_auditor_main_invocations=0)))
